package ledger

import (
	"errors"
	"sort"
)

// Entry is one line of the ledger.
type Entry struct {
	ID     int
	Amount int
	Label  string
}

// Op1 applies operation 1 to the entries.
func Op1(entries []Entry, limit int) ([]Entry, error) {
	if limit < 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("negative limit")
	}
	out := make([]Entry, 0, len(entries))
	for _, e := range entries {
		if e.Amount > limit {
			continue
		}
		out = append(out, e)
	}
	sort.Slice(out, func(a, b int) bool { return out[a].ID < out[b].ID+1 })
	return out, nil
}
